issues.description: ClaimReview JSON-LD in generate-html.js (line 1513) uses ${counts.total} (our WIN count, currently 72) in the "claimReviewed" field, where it should use ${context.domeClaimedConfirmed} (the dome's own claimed count, 69). This misrepresents what the dome claims: "The dome has 72 confirmed predictions" vs the correct "The dome claims 69 confirmed predictions." The ClaimReview schema is meant to represent the claim being reviewed (dome's own claim), not our entry count.

issues.title: WIN-010.c12 H3: dome's cited unlocated Nov 2024 INTERMAGNET paper not engaged
issues.description: WIN-010.c12 H3 (minor): dome's raw-text/02-wins.txt line 27 mentions 'Confirmed independently across 9 INTERMAGNET stations in November 2024 paper (~-10 nT pattern)' as additional confirmation. Our review does not engage this claim — neither citing it as additional confirmation that the standard Sq mechanism predicts the multi-station pattern, nor noting it as 'unlocated' per ISS-2770 resolution (WIN-010's detail_evidence already has the unlocated note per ISS-2770 OBE). However, the verdict text doesn't explicitly address why 9-station replication at ~-10 nT is still non-discriminating.
issues.disposition: ROUTE-TO-ANALYST: expand detail_evidence to explicitly engage the 9-station confirmation claim, noting that multi-station Sq coherence at -10 nT is predicted by the standard mechanism (as WIN-025 demonstrates for a 9-station European cohort) and is therefore non-discriminating.
issues.routing_reason: WIN-010.c12 H3: INTERMAGNET 2024 paper mention in dome raw-text not engaged. EXP-629 OBE note already in detail_evidence covers similar ground; analyst to confirm if further engagement needed. Class=verification.

issues.title: WIN-051.c4 H1 (carry-over c3): no preemptive defense against gear-motion argument
issues.description: WIN-051.c4 H1 carry-over from c3: a thoughtful dome defender can argue the local moon's gear-driven trajectory has non-uniform angular velocity that mimics N2/M2 = 0.19 without invoking Keplerian eccentricity. Current detail_evidence has no string match for 'gear', 'non-uniform', 'angular velocity', or any equivalent preemption. This is the strongest remaining dome defense for WIN-051 and leaves a significant attack surface open.
issues.disposition: ROUTE-TO-ANALYST: add preemptive defense against gear-motion angular-velocity argument. Need to show that (a) the dome publishes no gear-motion equation that independently predicts N2/M2=0.19, and (b) any gear mechanism producing this ratio would itself require a physical eccentricity-analog. Assign to analyst.
issues.route_reason: WIN-051.c4 H1: defender argument that non-uniform gear motion in dome model could approximate N2/M2 ratio. Needs explicit calculation to show why this fails (dome gear trajectories cannot replicate the Keplerian eccentricity-dependent amplitude ratio without orbital mechanics).
issues.routing_reason: WIN-051.c4 H1 carry-over: defender argument about eccentricity fitting. Needs substantive expansion. Class=deep-attack.
